configuration.final_fit: median epoch and epoch-wise median learning rate from 15 inner histories

protocol.selection: earliest minimum INNER unweighted BCE; outer results never select checkpoint
protocol.primary_endpoint: OOF character accuracy at repetition15, both subjects and all seeds
protocol.limitations: Exploratory on previously inspected subjects/folds; prior official Test exposure is not erased. No final training, Test scoring, significance test or automatic model selection.

comparison.limits: Exploratory OOF CV, not official Test. Seed/fold rows are correlated, not independent participants. No automatic selection or significance claim.
